description: Assessment quality auditor daemon. Every 86400s: reviews recent verdicts for quality issues: (1) servers with verdict but confidence<0.3 (2) servers where all 6 signals are identical score (possible scoring bug) (3) servers assessed >30 days ago not reassessed (4) TRUSTED_GENERAL servers with any HIGH/CRITICAL threat associations (contradiction). For each issue: ws_write corrections table {agent_id=zo_sentinel.auditor,action=assessment_quality_issue,reason=description,cluster=data_quality}. Write AUDIT_REPORT.md. Heartbeat.
